offers.title: Audit Automation Intern
offers.description:
Our users trust bunq to operate safely, transparently, and in line with regulations. To keep that trust, our System Checker (Internal Audit) team is moving to the next gen of auditing through automation, dashboards, and Artificial Intelligence and focus on identifying (emerging) risks, challenging processes, and improving quality. System Checker doesn’t want to spend valuable time on repetitive manual tasks. 

As our Audit Automation Intern, you’ll help automate audit activities through AI-driven solutions and smarter tooling. From evidence collection and issue tracking to reporting and workflow optimization, your work will help System Checker move faster, scale better, and focus on higher-value analysis and risk management.

Through your work, you’ll help reduce operational costs, improve audit speed, and support safer scalable growth for bunq. 🤖
offers.requirements:
• Assist in identifying repetitive audit tasks & processes that can be automated through AI, AI agents, and tooling.

  • Assist with building new AI End-to-End flows using various LLM models

  • Support the design, testing, and implementation of audit automation solutions across the team.

  • Help improve audit execution speed, reporting workflows, and issue tracking processes.

  • Work with System Checkers  and stakeholders to validate the new workflows and help with  adoption.

    This challenge is perfect for you if:

    • You have strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

    • You are interested in AI, automation, audit, risk, or process optimization.

    • You enjoy solving operational problems and improving workflows.

offers.title: Copywriting Intern
offers.description:
At bunq, we Make Life Easy, and so does our content. As our Copywriting Intern, you will contribute to making every line across our ads, website/blogs, and social media clear, helpful, and actionable for our users. You’ll help craft messaging that grabs attention and support the content team by turning ideas, insights, and trends into content that actually performs.

Ready to help us turn words into impact? 🚀

Take ownership

  • Contribute ideas and copy variations for ads and social campaigns, helping the team test and learn faster ✍️

  • Turn competitor and social trend research into actionable insights — identify patterns, spot opportunities, and propose messaging angles that differentiate bunq 🔎

  • Create and manage engaging blog and website content to support brand awareness and marketing goals.

  • Support campaign testing by proposing A/B ideas for headlines, hooks, and messaging variations to learn what resonates across markets 📊
offers.requirements:
• You’re fluent in written and spoken English

  • You’re available 5 days & 40 hours a week for 3 months.

  • You’re currently studying or recently graduated in English, Media, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a similar field

  • You have strong writing skills and can adapt tone for ads, social media, and marketing content

  • You understand the basics of digital marketing and why hooks, headlines, and variations matter

  • You’re curious about why certain messages perform better than others

  • You enjoy researching competitor campaigns, social trends, and messaging patterns

  • You can turn research into clear insights and practical content ideas

  • You have strong attention to detail and are comfortable receiving feedback and revising your work

  • You have experience running or contributing to social media accounts (strong plus ⭐)

  • You’re eager to learn and excited to contribute to marketing that actually drives impact

offers.title: Head of Product
offers.description:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.

Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.

Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant.

As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free.

Take ownership:
As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience:

  • Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area.

  • Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on.
offers.requirements:
• You’ve led a technical product organization and can get hands-on when needed. Size of organization isn’t the bar.

  • You have product leadership experience in a regulated financial services setting.

  • You understand payments and fraud, and you have data analysis skills and engineering depth.

  • You have experience working with regulators and across multiple markets.

  • You’re skilled at stakeholder management at management-board level.

  • You have AI fluency at the AI Architect level: you design AI-native systems, not only use AI tools.
